row.team_price_text: Team: $4/u/mo annual ($5 monthly), up to 10 users
row.evidence: Codecov's pricing page says "SAML is indirectly supported via your SSO Provider and GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket" and limits direct SSO to dedicated enterprise cloud; Okta login (OIDC) is Enterprise-only and no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Codecov (owned by Sentry) has no SCIM: users sign in with GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket and org membership comes from the Git provider. Enterprise (Custom Pricing) adds an Okta OIDC login gate in front of private repos (customer builds their own Okta OIDC app; not in the OIN) and, on Dedicated Cloud, Okta as the only login. Plans: Developer free (1 user), Team $4/user/mo annual or $5 monthly (max 10 users), Pro $12/user/mo (billing period not stated), Enterprise custom. The public REST API can list users and PATCH 'activated' to assign or free seats.

plans.notes: 1 user on private repos; unlimited for open source.

plans.price_text: $4 per user/month annual; $5 per user/month monthly

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: OKTA login checked only for Enterprise (read from page markup); SAML* row is checked on all plans but means SAML via your Git provider.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented in the docs index (llms.txt), API reference or pricing page. Users and org membership come from the Git provider (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) on sign-in; 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Personal access token from the user's own Settings > Access, sent as 'Authorization: bearer'.

capabilities.notes: PATCH only toggles 'activated', which assigns or frees a private-repo seat; users themselves come from the Git provider. List filters: activated, is_admin, search.

endpoints.purpose: List users of an org (paginated; filter activated, is_admin, search)
List users' login sessions (org admin only)

okta.notes: Not in the OIN; customers create their own Okta OIDC web app and enter its client ID/secret in Codecov org settings (Enterprise).

fallbacks.other_sync: Users and admins sync from the Git provider (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket) on login; service-provider admins are Codecov admins automatically.
